## Triage: graded p1 · `domain:engine` · `area:records` · `bug` · `pm:queue`

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post #6015) · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-22T14:01Z. ⛔ Not a claim.

This is the save-door half of #25168 (ADR-0015 §4.2): `saveMetaItem` is `packages/metadata*`, which is `domain:engine`'s. It is the same rule and the same route the maintainer was told of on #25168, a metadata-protocol narrowing handled in 18.x. It covers:
- the object and datasource save doors;
- the reverse direction (a datasource changed to `managed` under stored `external` objects);
- `composeStacks`' artifact pass.

Measure the two inferred readings first.

Claim: PM loop (card thread) · 2026-10-22T15:14Z · p1, `bug`, `domain:engine`. ADR-0015 §4.2's save-door half (#25168 follow-up): the object and datasource save doors, the reverse direction, and `composeStacks`' artifact pass judge an `external` binding against its datasource's `schemaMode` through the one spec predicate.

File surface:
- **Measured first:** the save-door reading, the reverse direction, `composeStacks`, and which door every write path crosses.
- `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts` (object and datasource save doors) and its tests;
- `packages/spec/src/data/external-binding-datasource.ts` (export only; the rule does not change), its api-surface row, and `packages/spec/src/stack.zod.ts` (`composeStacks`) if the measurement says so — cross-lane, declared to `domain:spec` on #18549;
- `content/docs/data-modeling/external-datasources.mdx` (the stale example);
- a semantic migration entry if the narrowing owes one (PR #25192's precedent), changesets, pins, an ablation.
(stop on breach; explain in the report)
⛔ Not in scope: `objectql`; the predicate's rule itself; the Sync half (#24837, closed); any other ADR-0015 clause.
Container & model: `M`, `mode:thread`, `model: TIER_DEFAULT` (build), `effort: xhigh`. Review: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` (a narrowing of what an author can write; `packages/spec/**` touched).
Clause-②: no (narrowing) (provisional, PR #25192's precedent; the export is one added api-surface row — the dev measures the declaration closure and corrects this line, with its arm, in the report)
Metadata-protocol: narrowed (provisional; the save door refuses what it stored)
Responsibility: the object and datasource save doors store an `external` binding on a managed datasource the stack does not declare | `ObjectSchema`'s refinement and `defineStack`'s cross-reference pass judge it at parse and at stack definition (#25168) | every author who saves an object or datasource through the metadata API
Thread-read: 6342661544
Serial constraints cleared: open PRs on `protocol.ts`'s save door and on `external-binding-datasource.ts` / `stack.zod.ts` re-checked at claim time.
Maintainer channel: a metadata-protocol narrowing under 「协议变更直接处理，排查相关的任务，和我沟通」 (quoted on #25168); the seat tells the maintainer at dispatch and at landing.
